title: Kissed Venezuelan Beans Bake
description: A hearty, earthy bean bake infused with nutmeg and citrus, wrapped in corn husks for a unique twist.
instructions: Rinse the cooked black beans and set aside.
Finely dice the onion and mince the garlic.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté onion and garlic until translucent.
Add the cumin, smoked paprika, and nutmeg, cooking for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in the black beans, orange juice, and chopped cilantro, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Transfer the mixture into a large corn husk, folding the edges to seal tightly.
Place the wrapped husk on a baking sheet and bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.
Remove from oven and carefully unroll the husk, spreading the beans into a baking dish.
Bake again at 375°F for 15 minutes until the top is slightly caramelized.
Serve hot, garnished with extra cilantro if desired.
